57:mcitU|### The prompt cache
58:47DEQ|
59:k-9gY|The tools of a run do not change, and pi-action reads the context files, the system prompt files, and the skills one time for each run. Thus, each section has the same text in all requests of a run, and the prompt cache of the provider stays valid.
60:47DEQ|
61:sxlLZ|A thread from an earlier version of pi-action gets the new sections in its next request. Because the new sections come before the sections that the thread already has, pi-durable removes the sections and adds them again in the new order, one time.

63:DMyZ8|### Context files
64:47DEQ|
65:yGe6N|pi-action loads context files as pi's coding agent does:
66:47DEQ|
67:T3ahO|1. **Global:** `<agent_dir>/AGENTS.md`, or else `<agent_dir>/CLAUDE.md`. Only when `agent_dir` is set.
68:zZ22F|2. **Workspace:** for each directory from the workspace root (`GITHUB_WORKSPACE`) down to the working directory of the agent: `AGENTS.md`, or else `CLAUDE.md`. Today, the working directory is the workspace root. pi-action never reads files above the workspace.
69:XNxcM|3. **Nested files** below the working directory (for example `packages/api/AGENTS.md`) are not loaded. The section lists their paths (up to 20) and tells pi to read the one for the directory where it works. pi-action finds them with `git ls-files`, so it ignores the files that git ignores.

87:7mfpx|- **Size.** `context_files_max_bytes` (default 64 KiB) limits all files together. pi-action cuts the file at the limit, adds a note for pi, leaves out later files, and writes a warning to the log.
88:lbZl0|- **Text.** pi-action removes invisible characters, as for the issue body (see [Security](security.md#what-pi-action-removes-from-text)). It keeps HTML comments.
89:UNV3m|- **One read for each run.** pi-action reads the files when the run starts. If pi changes `AGENTS.md` during the run, the system prompt stays the same, and the prompt cache of the provider stays valid. The next run on the thread sends the new content as an update of the section.
90:y3VlR|- **Pull requests from forks.** pi-action reads the files from the base commit of the pull request, not from the checkout. See [Security](security.md#context-files-from-the-repository).
91:8u-Yi|- **The log.** The setup group shows the files, for example `Context files: AGENTS.md (2.1 KiB)`.
